title: Career Roadmap: Geoscientist (ONGC/GSI after PG)
summary: Career Domain: Environment, Energy & Sustainability · Qualification Pathway: B.Sc – Geology / Earth Science · Target Career: Geoscientist (ONGC/GSI after PG)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

about.label: Important
about.text: Check the UPSC notification each year for the exact qualifying degrees and age limits.

blocks.text: A Geoscientist studies rocks, minerals, groundwater and the Earth's structure to find resources and understand hazards. Government geoscientist posts at GSI, ONGC and similar bodies need a postgraduate degree; a B.Sc in Geology is the first step.
What a Geoscientist (ONGC/GSI after PG) does

items.text: Map rocks and structures in the field
Analyse samples, cores and geophysical data
Assess mineral, oil, gas or groundwater potential
Write survey reports and maps
Geological Survey of India (GSI)
ONGC, Oil India and mining companies
Central Ground Water Board and state geology departments
Consultancies for mining, tunnels and dams
Learn mineralogy, petrology and physical geology
Go on every field trip and keep a field notebook
Learn map reading and basic GIS
Study structural geology, stratigraphy and palaeontology
Learn QGIS and basic remote sensing
Attend a field camp and practise geological mapping

blocks.text: Year 3: Prepare for the PG and exams

items.text: Do a project with field data or a lab analysis
Start preparing for the UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist exam syllabus
Apply for M.Sc Geology / Applied Geology

blocks.label: Note
blocks.text: GSI, CGWB and similar posts are filled through the UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, which needs a PG. ONGC recruits geoscientists through GATE (GG).

items.text: Brunton compass and GPS
QGIS / ArcGIS
Petrological microscope
Petrel or other subsurface software (later)
GSI or state geology department summer training
Mining or cement companies
Groundwater consultancies
GIS / remote sensing courses (IIRS Dehradun online courses)
NPTEL courses in geology and geophysics

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.

items.text: M.Sc Geology / Applied Geology / Geophysics
M.Tech Applied Geology / Petroleum Geoscience
Ph.D.

blocks.text: Entrance exams and tests to know:

items.text: UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination
GATE (GG)
CSIR-NET (Earth Sciences)
MSc in Petroleum Geoscience or Mining Geology (UK, Australia, Canada)

blocks.text: Roles a Geoscientist (ONGC/GSI after PG) can grow into or move across to:

items.text: Hydrogeologist
Mining Geologist
Environmental Geologist
GIS Analyst
